# 2 Chronicles Chapter 35 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** And-he-made Josiah in-Jerusalem Passover to-YHWH and-they-slaughtered the-Passover on-fourteen of-the-month the-first.

**2** And-he-stationed the-priests on their-duties and-he-strengthened-them for-service-of house-of YHWH.

**3** And-he-said to-the-Levites the-understanding for-all Israel the-holy to-YHWH put the-ark the-holy in-the-house that built Solomon son-of David king-of Israel there-is-not to-you burden on-the-shoulder now serve YHWH your-God and-His-people Israel.

**4** And-prepare according-to-houses-of your-fathers according-to-your-divisions according-to-writing-of David king-of Israel and-according-to-writing-of Solomon his-son.

**5** And-stand in-the-sanctuary according-to-divisions-of houses-of fathers of-your-brothers sons-of the-people and-portion-of house-of father to-the-Levites.

**6** And-slaughter the-Passover and-consecrate-yourselves and-prepare for-your-brothers to-do according-to-word-of YHWH by-hand-of Moses.

**7** And-he-contributed Josiah for-sons-of the-people sheep lambs and-kids-of goats all for-the-Passovers for-all the-found to-number-of thirty thousand and-cattle three-thousand these from-possessions-of the-king.

**8** And-his-princes for-freewill-offering for-the-people for-the-priests and-for-the-Levites they-contributed Hilkiah and-Zechariah and-Jehiel leaders-of house-of God for-the-priests they-gave for-Passovers two-thousand and-six-hundred and-cattle three-hundred.

**9** And-Conaniah and-Shemaiah and-Nethanel his-brothers and-Hashabiah and-Jeiel and-Jozabad princes-of the-Levites contributed for-the-Levites for-Passovers five-thousand and-cattle five-hundred.

**10** And-was-established the-service and-they-stood the-priests on their-station and-the-Levites on their-divisions according-to-commandment-of the-king.

**11** And-they-slaughtered the-Passover and-they-dashed the-priests from-their-hand and-the-Levites were-skinning.

**12** And-they-removed the-burnt-offering to-give-them according-to-divisions of-house-of the-fathers to-sons-of the-people to-offer to-YHWH as-written in-book-of Moses and-so for-the-cattle.

**13** And-they-roasted the-Passover in-the-fire according-to-the-rule and-the-holy-things they-boiled in-the-pots and-in-the-caldrons and-in-the-pans and-they-carried-quickly to-all sons-of the-people.

**14** And-after they-prepared for-themselves and-for-the-priests for the-priests sons-of Aaron were-in offering the-burnt-offering and-the-fat-portions until night and-the-Levites prepared for-themselves and-for-the-priests sons-of Aaron.

**15** And-the-singers sons-of Asaph were-on their-station according-to-commandment-of David and-Asaph and-Heman and-Jeduthun seer-of the-king and-the-gatekeepers at-gate and-gate not they-needed to-turn from-upon their-service for their-brothers the-Levites prepared for-them.

**16** And-was-established all service-of YHWH in-the-day that to-make the-Passover and-to-offer burnt-offerings on altar-of YHWH according-to-commandment-of the-king Josiah.

**17** And-they-made sons-of Israel the-found the-Passover at-the-time that and-feast-of the-unleavened-bread seven days.

**18** And-not was-made Passover like-it in-Israel from-days-of Samuel the-prophet and-all kings-of Israel not made like-the-Passover that made Josiah and-the-priests and-the-Levites and-all Judah and-Israel the-found and-inhabitants-of Jerusalem.

**19** In-year eighteen of-reign-of Josiah was-made this Passover.

**20** After all this when prepared Josiah the-house he-came-up Neco king-of Egypt to-fight at-Carchemish on the-Euphrates and-he-went-out Josiah to-meet-him.

**21** And-he-sent to-him messengers saying what to-me and-to-you king-of Judah not against-you I am-coming today but to house-of my-war and-God said to-hurry-me cease for-yourself from God who is-with-me and-not let-Him-destroy-you.

**22** And-not turned Josiah his-face from-him but to-fight against-him he-disguised-himself and-not he-listened to-words-of Neco from-mouth-of God and-he-came to-fight in-valley-of Megiddo.

**23** And-they-shot the-archers at-the-king Josiah and-he-said the-king to-his-servants take-me-away for I-am-wounded very.

**24** And-they-took-him his-servants from the-chariot and-they-mounted-him on chariot-of the-second that was-for-him and-they-brought-him to-Jerusalem and-he-died and-he-was-buried in-tombs-of his-fathers and-all Judah and-Jerusalem were-mourning for Josiah.

**25** And-he-lamented Jeremiah over Josiah and-they-spoke all the-singers and-the-songstresses in-their-laments over Josiah to this day and-they-made-them a-statute upon Israel and-behold-them written on the-laments.

**26** And-rest-of acts-of Josiah and-his-lovingkindnesses according-to-the-written in-law-of YHWH

**27** and-his-acts the-first and-the-last behold-them written on book-of kings-of Israel and-Judah.


---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **35:18**: from-days-of Samuel the-prophet — Josiah's Passover surpasses even Hezekiah's (30:26, which was compared to Solomon's). This is the greatest worship event in Israel's history.

- **35:22**: not he-listened to-words-of Neco from-mouth-of God — The tragic irony: God speaks through an Egyptian pharaoh, and Josiah — the most faithful king — refuses to listen. Obedience to God's voice matters more than the identity of the messenger.


— EMET
